name: project-task-management-system
description: This simple web app helps you organize your tasks. 📝 With HTML , CSS and JAVASCRIPT, you can add ➕, view 👀, edit ✏️, and delete 🗑️ tasks. Tasks are saved in your browser 💾. You can switch between 🌙 Dark Mode and 🌞 Light Mode. Perfect for students 📚 and professionals . Future updates may include reminders 🔔, task sharing , 🚀
